boundaries: A disposition does not admit a definition or authorize participant data collection.
Retirement stops new assignment but does not rewrite historical responses or research evidence.
claim_ceiling: Generated project-scoped candidate Definition record only. Shape and projection checks grant no Lab admission, semantic truth, implementation, collection or employment-use authority.

exclusions: Any other product or Lab-wide meaning without separate owner review and admission.

domain_context.explanation: Candidate Case Disposition meaning for the Engineer Assessment product and research program. Its construct, implementation and use claims remain bounded by the source statement.

plain_language.explanation: It records who decided whether a question can enter or leave the live bank and why.

scientific_formal.normative_statement: A Case Disposition is an attributable decision under an assigned case-bank role to reject, revise, hold, release or retire an exact case version for a named use, citing reviews, exposure, rubric compatibility and effective time.
